solutions.title: Normalize and reverse
solutions.strategy: Create a lowercase alphanumeric copy, then compare it with its reverse.

timeComplexity.explanation: The input is scanned to normalize and the normalized sequence is compared once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The normalized character sequence can contain most of the input.

solutions.title: Skipping two pointers
solutions.strategy: Move inward, skipping ignored characters and comparing normalized endpoints.

timeComplexity.explanation: The left and right pointers move across the string once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only pointer indices and temporary characters are stored.
